Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_045769.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_045769.v · Open raw
module origen_045769 #(
    parameter ABUS_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter DBUS_WIDTH = 32
) (
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    input wire [ABUS_WIDTH-1:0] aBus,
    inout wire [DBUS_WIDTH-1:0] dBus,
    input wire wrtEn,
    input wire [3:0] keys,
    output wire IRQ
);

    reg [3:0] kdata;
    reg [8:0] kctrl;
    reg oneTimeKInit;

    wire readData = (aBus == 32'hF0000010);
    wire writeCtrl = (aBus == 32'hF0000110) && wrtEn;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            kdata <= 4'b0000;
            kctrl <= 9'b000000000;
            oneTimeKInit <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
            if (oneTimeKInit) begin
                kdata <= keys;
                oneTimeKInit <= 1'b0;
            end else if (kdata != keys) begin
                kdata <= keys;
                if (kctrl[0]) begin
                    kctrl[2] <= 1'b1;
                end
                kctrl[0] <= 1'b1;
            end

            if (readData) begin
                kctrl[0] <= 1'b0;
            end

            if (writeCtrl) begin
                kctrl[2] <= dBus[2];
                kctrl[8] <= dBus[8];
            end
        end
    end

    assign IRQ = kctrl[0];

    assign dBus = (readData) ? {28'b0, kdata} :
                  (aBus == 32'hF0000110) ? {23'b0, kctrl} :
                  {DBUS_WIDTH{1'bz}};

endmodule
